strings: m_c often finds it easier to lie. All of these lies have piled up and gotten m_c into trouble.
m_c's Clanmates understand that this is a trauma response, but lying still has consequences.
It feels like m_c has another tongue. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/WANT/WANTS} to tell the truth, but it's like another tongue comes out and tells a lie for {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
